verdict.rationale: Fivetran's official MCP server lets users query sync status and manage connections via natural-language questions to an LLM, and its Connector SDK ships AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) enabling natural-language connector build/test/deploy. However, this is limited to specific workflows (monitoring/connector dev) rather than full natural-language operation of the core product (pipeline setup, transformations, admin) via chat. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over the broader dashboard/transformations/general account operations, and independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability.
